q1_issues.issue: The NP-internal PP "between Cincinnati Reds and Boston Red Sox" is promoted to two Agent role atoms on the series entity, but the instruction set says a PP is decided by the question it answers (never by the closest listed role) and an entity-attached preposition keeps its surface form, so this states a role relation the clause does not.
Same issue on the second conjunct: boston_red_sox is given an Agent role rather than the surface preposition-named attachment.

sk_series_1 is simultaneously an entity filling the Theme slot of sk_play_1 (statement 6) and an eventuality bearing Agent role atoms, so one symbol is used on both sides of the event-vs-entity distinction.

q2_gaps: the determiner "another N" (additive/repetitive determiner presupposing a prior one of the same kind) - the aspectual section covers "again/still/already/yet" on eventualities but nothing covers this NP-level presupposition, and the parse drops it entirely

a two-argument "between X and Y" post-modifier on an entity noun - the instruction set illustrates entity-attached prepositions only for the one-argument "from" case and gives no shape for a symmetric two-relatum preposition
notes: The agentless passive, Past, Location on the event, and the Theme default for an unclear change test are all handled per the instruction set, and both multi-word team names are single opaque symbols with their required Name atoms. The whole content of "another" is unrepresented.
